LAW AND MOTION 301, THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT BEBE STORES INCORPORATED'S MOTION TO FILE DOCUMENTS UNDER SEAL IS GRANTED. MOVING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189 301/PJB

LAW AND MOTION 301, THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT BEBE STORES INCORPORATED'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS DENIED. PLAINTIFF HAS RAISED A TRIABLE ISSUE OF MATERIAL FACT THROUGH HER DECLARATION AS TO WHETHER DEFENDANTS BASIS FOR FIRING HER WAS A PRETEXT ESPECIALLY IN LIGHT OF EVIDENCE THAT HER MANAGER REPEATEDLY TOLD HER TO STOP COMPLAINING ABOUT REST PERIOD ISSUES AND AS TO WHETHER THERE WERE OCCASIONS ON WHICH PLAINTIFF WAS DENIED LUNCH PERIODS AND BREAKS BY BEING REQUIRED TO PERFORM WORK DUTIES. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER PURSUANT TO CCP 437 C(G). JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189 301/PJB
